title: Rhythm without recruitment: analysis code, derived data and verification
description: Simulation pipeline, analysis and verification code, derived result files and figure scripts accompanying the manuscript 'Rhythm without recruitment: a falsification-first audit of a connectome-constrained ventral nerve cord model as a controller for a simulated Drosophila body' (Yupeng Ning, 2026). The repository contains the simulation pipeline that produced the saved results of the published MANC rate model (Pugliese et al.), and re-derives every number and figure of the paper from those results, including a re-analysis of all 128 author-saved parameter sets, a full-network integrator convergence test, and a 53-item check of the manuscript's quantitative claims.
